messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — gateway-proxy-503-502-spike. Severity: P1. 5xx rate crossed 18% on edge-gateway for us-east-1. Pager routed to oncall: Olivia (oncall-sre). Please acknowledge and triage. https://console.redwood.example/alerts/1738501234
Olivia (oncall-sre): acked. looking at metrics now. any recent deploys to edge in last 30m? :eyes:
Ben (edge): there's a canary pushed ~22m ago for a change to HTTP keepalive handling on the edge proxy. I saw a small bump earlier but it looked self-resolved.
Olivia (oncall-sre): pulling request id + logs. sending initial blast to zoom.
infra-bot: Zoom meeting (incident-1738501234) created: https://zoom.redwood/incident-1738501234 - dial-in pinned to oncall.
Olivia (oncall-sre): dashboard: https://observability.redwood/edge/gateway/errors?since=15m - spike starts ~1738501000. 502 and 504 primarily; backend latency healthy for most services.
Alice (platform): stack traces show upstream 502s, but error budget looks consumed at proxy tier. I'm seeing a surge of connection resets from the keeper-proxy pool.
Carol (support): we're already getting customer tickets complaining about failed requests. ETA on mitigation?
Olivia (oncall-sre): immediate mitigations I'm trying: 1) shift % of traffic away from us-east-1 edge nodes to us-west-2 failover pool 2) enable proxy circuit-breaker to short-circuit failing backends 3) roll back canary if correlation confirmed. Doing 1 now.
Ben (edge): I'm running the traffic-shift playbook: `./ops/traffic-shift --from=us-east-1 --to=us-west-2 --percent=40`
Deepak (devex): heads up — shifting traffic will increase p99 egress to us-west-2, watch costs but do it if it reduces customer impact.
Olivia (oncall-sre): applied 40% shift at 1738501105. watching.
Olivia (oncall-sre): after 2m, 5xx dropped from 18% -> 9% overall but still high on a subset of nodes.
Ben (edge): correlating node IDs: edge-eu1-12 is fine, edge-us1-07 and edge-us1-09 showing repeated `502 upstream read timeout` in logs.
Alice (platform): those nodes are running the recent canary. digging into proxy keepalive config for those hosts.
Olivia (oncall-sre): quick test curl against a failing node:
```
curl -v -H 'Host: api.redwood.example' 'https://edge-us1-07.internal:443/health' -I
* Connected to edge-us1-07.internal (10.0.7.23) port 443 (#0)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake ...
> GET /health HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.example
> User-Agent: curl/7.85.0
> Accept: */*
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< content-type: application/json
< x-edge-error: upstream-read-timeout
```
Olivia (oncall-sre): logs show repeated `upstream-read-timeout` and `connection reset by peer` during keepalive re-use.
Ben (edge): canary change reuses keepalive pools across backend groups; suspect idle timeout mismatch with backend LB. I'll flip the canary routing to not reuse idle connections.
Ben (edge): applying hotfix to canary: set `keepalive_reuse=false` for canary instances. rolling now to edge-us1-07, edge-us1-09.
infra-bot: Rolling update started for instances [edge-us1-07, edge-us1-09] (canary)
Olivia (oncall-sre): toggled proxy circuit-breaker to `fail-open=false` so failing backends are cut earlier — should reduce error amplification.
Carol (support): posting templated status update to customers now: "We are investigating elevated errors affecting API requests in US-East. Mitigation underway; we will update in 30 minutes."
Emma (product): please include: "Some requests may return 502/504; no data loss reported; recommended retry after 5s."
Deepak (devex): added a short-lived retry wrapper to hosted-api SDK (server-side) for the next 15m using exponential backoff; pushed feature flag to reduce user-facing errors.
Olivia (oncall-sre): after hotfix and circuit-breaker, overall 5xx in the cluster down to 3.7% at 1738501300. user-reported failures decreasing.
Ben (edge): canary instances restarted with `keepalive_reuse=false` at 1738501248. new logs show successful upstream handshakes.
Alice (platform): I recommend rolling the canary config global after one full stabilization window (10m) if no regressions.
Olivia (oncall-sre): agree. will keep 40% traffic shifted until next check.
Carol (support): customer queue: 21 open tickets, 5 high priority. I've prioritized replies for paying customers and added the status link.
Emma (product): capture list of affected customers and endpoints so CS can proactively reach out.
Olivia (oncall-sre): capture: mostly api write paths to `v1/batch` and `v1/parse`. attached example request ID list: `req_8a1, req_8a2, req_8a9, req_8b0` (samples in logs).
Ben (edge): start global rollout: `ops/config apply edge-proxy.keepalive_reuse=false --scope=global --if-stable=10m` (will wait).
Olivia (oncall-sre): monitoring p95+p99 and error-rate dashboards closely. Next check in 8 minutes.
incidents-bot: Reminder: run incident checklist item 3 (customer comms) and 5 (postmortem ticket creation).
Olivia (oncall-sre): creating postmortem ticket INT-2026-143 at https://issues.redwood/INT-2026-143 — adding timeline and initial mitigation notes.
Deepak (devex): small note — SDK retry flag is on; please remember to disable after incident to avoid masking underlying issues.
Alice (platform): after 12m stabilization, rolling full config to all edge nodes at 1738501405. patch applied to 100% by 1738501423.
Ben (edge): observed error rate fall to baseline ~0.6% by 1738501450.
Olivia (oncall-sre): starting traffic-shift rollback: moving 40% back to us-east-1 at 1738501470.
Olivia (oncall-sre): traffic fully restored to prior distribution by 1738501498. final 5xx sits at 0.7%.
Carol (support): closing immediate customer tickets with notes. sending follow-ups to high-touch customers with root-cause blurb.
Emma (product): thanks — please add a short blurb for release notes and internal runbook updates.
Olivia (oncall-sre): immediate incident status: mitigated. next steps: 1) postmortem draft in INT-2026-143 (owner: Olivia) 2) platform to add keepalive idle mismatch test in CI (owner: Alice) 3) devex to revert SDK retry flag after 24h (owner: Deepak) 4) CS to reach out to impacted accounts (owner: Carol).
Ben (edge): filing internal change CR for keepalive defaults and adding automated canary failure detection rule.
Carol (support): estimated customer impact: ~1200 failed requests over 20m window, ~45 customers touched, 5 premium customers. Will include in postmortem.
Olivia (oncall-sre): handing off to next oncall: @Ben please take watch for the next 60m and close this thread when stable.
Ben (edge): taking watch. ping me if anything creeps up. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident marked as mitigated at 1738501538. Please complete post-incident checklist in INT-2026-143 and label any follow-up RFCs.
Olivia (oncall-sre): thanks everyone. pulling a brief timeline and will dump initial notes into the ticket now.
Deepak (devex): nice quick recovery team. will draft a short blameless postmortem template for the ticket.
Emma (product): appreciate the fast coordination.
Carol (support): closing thread and updating customer status page.
Ben (edge): 1 final note — adding a synthetic check for keepalive reuse mismatch to our SLO alerts.
Olivia (oncall-sre): thread closed (mitigated).
